dwelling_habits.dwelling: Beaches, docks, and parking lots with a view of fries.
dwelling_habits.food: Fish, crabs, scraps — opportunistic beach comedians.
dwelling_habits.feeding: Pecks the wrack line; also follows boats for handouts.
dwelling_habits.mating: Nests in colonies on sandy islands.
dwelling_habits.socializing: Named for a laugh-like call that fills every pier.

fun_facts: That ‘ha-ha-ha’ call is why they’re never quiet vacation guests.
Summer black hoods molt to a winter smudge.
